correctness.rationale: Decompose X=tI+U,Y=sI+V with traceless U,V and split ternary norm Q(u,v,w)=u²+vw. The anticommutator equation is tV+sU=0 and ts+<U,V>=0; four disjoint scalar strata yield integer Fourier multiplier (1). For nonzero normal H, Q=1 plane-section counts are exactly 2q,q,2q−1,q−1,q+1 by its isotropic/square/nonsquare norm and height. For q>=5 this excludes zeros except two orientations of N12=2,N1+N2=2q+1; the affine-line discriminant gives χ(c²+2abc+Q(R)a²)=1 or swapped. Counting q²−1 isotropic nonzero P, q(q−1)²/2 nonsquare R, nonzero a, and (q−1)/2 admissible other scalars yields q(q²−1)(q−1)^4/2 exact Fourier zeros and convolution nullity. Independent exhaustive q=5 integer-geometric test checked 390625 frequency labels and 15360 zeros. The q=3 cutoff is essential; q=9 extension test code inspected but not independently run.
